original_text:
Nanda et al.\ \citeyear{nanda2023progress} used mechanistic
interpretability to trace the internal computation that emerges at the
transition, identifying a Fourier-based algorithm that networks discover when
they generalise on modular addition.

Nanda et al.\ \citeyear{nanda2023progress} used optimal
transport theory to trace the evolution of weight matrices during the

rationale: The edit completely rewrites the claim describing Nanda et al. (2023) to falsely attribute to it a result regarding optimal transport and Wasserstein-gradient flows, whereas the actual paper focuses entirely on mechanistic interpretability, ensuring an UNRELATED target verdict.
